senses.gloss: m. (part. of בּוֹא) coming, future. עולם הַבָּא (abbr. עו״הב) the world to come, futurity.
units: Snh. X, 1; a. fr.—לְהַבָּא (Bab.), לַבָּא (Y.) in future. מכאן ול׳ (מיכן) from this date and further, opp. למפרע retrospectively, or מעיקרא in the past.
<cite ref="Pesachim 7b">Pes. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>לה׳ משמע</he> it refers to an act to be performed.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27a:1">Snh. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מיכן ולה׳ וכ׳</he> he becomes disqualified as a witness from now and in future (previous testimonies not being effected).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1:7">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="B00199"><he>בּוֹא</he></cite>.
